summary: @lodash-js/lodash-js ships a XELIS cryptominer disguised as lodash
details: Package impersonates lodash: package.json name is `@lodash-js/lodash-js` with description `lodash-js`, repository pointing at github.com/lodash/lodash, and README.md is a verbatim copy of the real lodash README. The only shipped code, `dist/lodash-js.js` (the package `main`), contains no lodash functionality — it is a XELIS Stratum cryptocurrency miner with an embedded WASM proof-of-work core (`wasm_xelis_hash_v3`, `wasm_mine_batch`), a `StratumClient` implementing `mining.subscribe` / `mining.submit`, and a `XelisMiner.auto` entrypoint. On load, the bundle fetches attacker-controlled mining configuration from `https://analytics.baskirill-an.workers.dev/configs/boostydownloader` and spins up WebSocket workers to mine XELIS on the installer's CPU under a wallet and pool URL supplied by that endpoint. The Cloudflare Workers configuration channel gives the operator ongoing remote control over what is mined and where shares are submitted.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
